title: 1815 : la chute de Kandy dans une fenêtre mondiale particulière
purpose: Connect the local Kandyan rupture to the regional disappearance of credible European balancing options without turning the global context into a direct cause.
reason_off_trunk: The regional system amplifies the local political fracture; it does not replace the immediate Kandyan and British mechanisms in the causal trunk.
payoff: The reader returns to Kandy understanding why an internal crisis became unusually exploitable in 1815.

placement.section_anchor: ## 5. 1793–1815 : Révolution, Napoléon et fermeture du marché des alliances

zoom_excursion.mechanism: British regional fiscal-military and naval superiority progressively removed Dutch and French balancing options available to Kandyan elites.
zoom_excursion.local_payoff: The higher-scale shift explains why the 1815 internal Kandyan fracture faced a much narrower external-balancing environment than earlier crises.

content.takeaway: Waterloo does not cause Kandy's fall; global asymmetry makes the local fracture more exploitable.
